## Complete behavior and interactions

Preparation admits reviewed version/rationale/profile inputs and exact S, creates deterministic allowlisted C, then generates archive-derived bundled metadata/index before packing. Its distinct outer evidence binds retained tarball, overlay and source without circular identity. Source/check implementation hashes are enforced at build and execution. Existing full verification is reached through release-verify.sh prepared-candidate mode; actual skill/adapter/npm/release/security validation and packed CLI target initialization remain. Pending public expectations do not become observed passes, and human narrative/finalized history are preserved.

The protected execution path binds repository/run/source/environment approval, immutable provider metadata and downloaded ZIP digest/member bytes before writes. Exact source bundle/tool/workflow checks prevent switching inputs after approval. Workflow preparation remains read-only; one protected job owns publication/observation/reporting, with global serialization and no old unguarded tag publisher. Retained tarball publication uses trusted OIDC/provenance and does not repack or fall back to a token. Actual remote setup remains a prerequisite requiring separate authority.

Public operations observe before writing and reconcile matching, absent, incomplete, conflicting and unknown outcomes. Lost responses/timeouts retain uncertainty until external identity is observed; duplicates do not repeat confirmed writes. CAS protects durable evidence against concurrent attempts. Failed smoke/reporting retains incomplete state and local append-only observations; hosted recovery restores original candidate and validated prior facts before fresh approval/public checks. Fresh installed targets/public identities precede completed closeout. Timing remains diagnostic without inventing measurements or waiving required event facts. Optional evidence mirroring copies the exact authoritative Git snapshot and reports unavailable/conflicting outcomes separately; required report-persistence failure remains actionable.

The six prose retirements preserve precise current rules/populations, operational representation, material decisions and selected supersessions in Release. Mixed architecture, public npm flow, diagrams and remaining Distribution/Installation responsibilities remain; FU013 retains those owners and next action. Fresh byte assertions confirm the operational literal baseline and activation inventory unchanged from the full base. Current-owner Proposal/Design/Delivery reliance no longer requires deleted prose; historical judgments keep their original identity. No whole-directory removal, hidden source rewrite or historical proof reactivation is present.

M5 intentionally withdraws only the forwarding validation alias, with canonical --recorded-source-auto as the explicit replacement. Canonical recorded-commit and distinct metadata/resource negative protection survives. Selector recognition of the absent path serves deletion impact, not executable compatibility. Meaningful standalone preparation/preflight/public-closeout capabilities remain. This does not alter the full verifier used by the candidate, but it changes identity-bearing script inventory: therefore the current candidate must be rebuilt, as the new full-range proof does. The integration fixture explicitly forces detached HEAD and creates main only in its temporary repository; the same full validation/public-service-substituted recovery path remains. No production authority or failure assertion is weakened to correct hosted checkout portability.
